about.title: Menifee Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Menifee has grown quickly, and its roads carry the traffic to prove it. In 2025 the city recorded 312 injury collisions, with 477 people hurt and 7 lives lost. Newport Road, Menifee Road, Murrieta Road, and Scott Road account for the largest share of reported crashes, and Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. tend to be the busiest window. If one of those wrecks involved you or someone in your family, the calls and paperwork that follow can feel heavier than the crash itself. LawProactive exists to take one item off that list. We are not a law firm. We are a free service that connects Menifee residents with an independent personal injury attorney who handles car accident claims in Riverside County. That attorney works on contingency, so you owe nothing unless money is recovered. California generally gives you two years to file, though claims involving a public agency can require action in as little as six months. Reaching out early helps protect evidence, medical records, and your options.

whyChoose.title: Why Menifee Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Two Years Can Pass Faster Than You Think
items.desc: California gives most car accident victims two years to file suit, but claims against a city, county, or state agency may need to be started within six months. Connecting with an attorney early keeps those deadlines from becoming a problem.

items.title: Partial Fault Does Not End Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, meaning you can still recover even if you share some blame for the crash. Your recovery is simply reduced by your percentage of responsibility, and there is no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering.

items.title: No Fee Unless There Is a Recovery
items.desc: Our service is free, and every attorney in our network works on contingency. You pay attorney fees only if money is recovered in your case.

items.question: The other driver's insurer wants a recorded statement. Should I give one?
items.answer: You are not required to give the other side's insurance company a recorded statement, and it is usually wise not to before speaking with an attorney. Adjusters may use your words to argue you were partly at fault, which matters under California's comparative fault rules. Let a lawyer handle those conversations for you.

items.question: I was hit on Newport Road and think a broken signal or road defect played a part. Does that change anything?
items.answer: It might. If a City of Menifee or Riverside County agency is potentially responsible, a claim generally must be filed with that agency within six months rather than the usual two years. An attorney can evaluate whether a public entity is involved and act before that shorter window closes.

items.question: What should I save after a Menifee car accident?
items.answer: Keep photos of the vehicles, the scene, and your injuries, along with the police report number, witness contact information, and every medical bill or record. Hold onto damaged personal items and do not repair your car until it has been documented. The more you preserve now, the easier it is to show what happened later.
